nodes.name: Odido
highlights: Member of the Developer Experience / Core Platform team for Odido's consumer self-service web portals.
Introduced standard structured (ECS) logging across the NestJS back ends, with request context and aligned log/APM service identity, making requests traceable end to end in Elastic.
Built Kibana error-investigation and service-health dashboards for all environments, managed as code with drift detection.
Implemented personal-data redaction in logs (emails, phone numbers, personal fields, URL-encoded values) and stopped outbound API clients from logging payloads, headers and credentials.

Hardened CI and the supply chain: Dependabot plus a dependency-review gate that blocks high and critical vulnerabilities, and a CI check that catches NestJS dependency-injection failures before deploy.
Delivered account and authentication features end to end: change email and name, privacy settings, redirect-origin validation, and the migration off a legacy auth bridge.
Integrated consent management (Usercentrics), global search, Web Vitals monitoring (Elastic RUM) and automated sitemap generation, and contributed to the shared design system.
Reviewed code and backend architecture, and used AI coding agents in a governed, review-first workflow. 30+ merged pull requests in five months.
nodes.tech: TypeScript, NestJS (Fastify), Next.js/React, oRPC, Zod, Elastic APM/RUM, Kibana, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm, GitHub Actions, Vitest.

nodes.name: AzerothCore
highlights: Founder and lead developer of AzerothCore, an open-source, modular MMO server framework written in C++, started in 2016 and still in active development.
